entry.title: Give me the short version
entry.use_when: Less wall of text. More point.
entry.freshness: Review after use; verify current external facts before relying on them.
entry.limitations: A reusable prompt for an existing assistant; tool access and authority come from the actual task.

pattern.activation: long notes, a thread or a document are hiding the decision, change or action someone needs.

use_cases.title: Pull decisions from scattered notes
use_cases.outcome: A brief separating decisions, actions and open questions, with source locations.

links.why: After extracting the important points, shape them into a message for a particular recipient.
